en: Dependent on a state to be abandoned by seeing, a state to be abandoned by cultivation arises by way of root-condition.

Dependent on a state to be abandoned by seeing, a state to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by cultivation arises by way of root-condition. Dependent on a state to be abandoned by seeing, a state to be abandoned by cultivation...
And states that are to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation arise with a root condition. [Three.
Dependent on a state not to be abandoned by cultivation, a state to be abandoned by vision arises with a root condition.
Dependent on a state not to be abandoned by cultivation, a state to be abandoned neither by vision nor by cultivation [arises].

...arises by way of the root condition. Dependent on a state that is to be abandoned by vision, states that are both to be abandoned by vision and neither to be abandoned by vision nor by cultivation arise by way of the root condition ... three.
Dependent on a state that is neither to be abandoned by vision nor by cultivation, [states] that are neither to be abandoned by vision nor by cultivation ... [arise by way of the root condition].

A state to be abandoned by seeing arises conditioned by a cause. Dependent on a state to be abandoned neither by seeing nor by cultivation, a state to be abandoned by seeing arises conditioned by a cause … five. (Abbreviated.
Under the cause condition there are eighteen; under the object condition, nine … pe … under the result condition, three … pe … under the non-disappearance condition, eighteen.
